items.title: Louis Armstrong: Jazz Casual Interview, 1964-07-10
items.q: And the Dixon on the banjo, and we made out a little extra change like that.

ctx.x: Well, when they started to make these records, and you made a whole series of records accompanying singers, how did they bring you in? Did they heard you?

Yeah, well, I got that break when I was with Fletch Henderson, you know, at the Roadland. Yeah. And we would go down, like, one day to the trombone, the clarinet, and the cornet, then one day, all three of us. Yeah. And the Dixon on the banjo, and we made out a little extra change like that.
